purpose: Generate fewer higher-quality Phase-0 environment sketches under explicit anti-failure constraints, then run candidate-free micro-probes only if separately authorized.

batch_size.rationale: Prefer fewer high-quality sketches over 20 random variants that repeat direct-decode, graph-cache, passive-leak, metric-degenerate, lookup-artifact, or underpowered surfaces.

required_a1_a9_mapping.A1_direct_legal_channel_compute: explain why target is not exactly legal-channel computable under budget and how oracle-as-baseline will be scored
required_a1_a9_mapping.A2_graph_cache_transition_table_saturati: explain heldout structure that makes all six graph/cache members structurally insufficient
required_a1_a9_mapping.A3_lookup_under_memorization_split: explain why low lookup cannot be the only source of gap
required_a1_a9_mapping.A4_fitted_classical_learner: include fitted/classical learner and expected failure mode
required_a1_a9_mapping.A5_passive_decoder_leakage: include value-level passive leakage scan and expected floor
required_a1_a9_mapping.A6_metric_degeneracy: include balanced macro-F1, per-class floors, and degenerate controls
required_a1_a9_mapping.A7_oracle_not_budget_faithful: separate answer-key diagnostic oracle from budget-faithful visible oracle
required_a1_a9_mapping.A8_baseline_aliasing_fake_diversity: require producer and prediction hashes plus alias collapse
required_a1_a9_mapping.A9_split_defeats_memory_not_compute: show same heldout split defeats memory and simple compute

promotion_rule_for_003a.promotion_target: separate full baseline-first harness task card only

stop_conditions: blocked_no_valid_environment_design_grammar if only available gap comes from weakening baselines
reject_direct_decode if legal compute enters oracle band
reject_graph_cache_saturated if graph/cache family max enters oracle band
reject_passive_decodable if passive family max reaches passive floor
reject_metric_degenerate if degenerate or size-only controls saturate
reject_oracle_not_budget_faithful if oracle reads forbidden or over-budget fields
reject_underpowered_surface if visible oracle does not clear signal floor
reject_no_headroom_likely if compute/fitted baseline reaches oracle band on heldout split
blocked_baseline_battery_incomplete if any mandatory row is absent or unconsumed
blocked_baseline_aliasing_invalidates_promotion if aliasing is needed for positive corroboration
claim_ceiling: 003A, if later authorized, remains candidate-free Phase-0 environment portfolio scouting only. No headroom confirmation, no Gate1 pass, no mechanism validity, no candidate feasibility, no runtime/mainline effect, and no agency/autonomy/consciousness/EGO readiness.
